title: 6,865 sq.ft Showroom · Times Square Grand, Bodakdev
address: Times Square Grand, Sindhu Bhavan Marg, Bodakdev, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380059
description: Ground floor showroom in Times Square Grand, Bodakdev, with 6,865 sq.ft super built up and 3,775 sq.ft carpet and a 35 ft frontage.

Set in a G+7 building with 4 lifts and 17 units per floor, 1 to 5 years old. Rent is ₹70 per sq.ft on super built up or ₹128 per sq.ft on carpet. Well suited to Furniture, Restaurant, Clothing, Garments, Designer and Salon.
